title: Dhadkan bole ali
body:
Ali - ali, ali - ali, ali - ali, ali - ali, ali - ali, yaa ali
hoo....
Ali hal ataa, ali innama, ali kulkafa, ali badshah
ali bandagi, ali zindagi, ali aagahi, ali roshni
Hoo..
Ishq e ali hai dil ki manzil
phir kaisa ghum kaisi mushkil
is naam ka kare wird mera dil, mera dil
seene mein dil hai, dil mein hai dhadkan
maula maula, maula maula
seene mein dil hai, dil mein hai dhadkan
dhadkan bole ali ali..(2)
Tera bhi maula, mera bhi maula
Hum sab ka maula ali ali
seene mein dil hai, dil mein hai dhadkan
dhadkan bole ali ali..
dhadkan dhadkan ali ali, dhadkan dhadkan ali ali
maula maula, maula maula

Ehsaas mein har saans mein rehta hai ali
haan seene mein dil banke dhadakta hai ali
bijli mein mere maula ke lehje ki dhadak hai
dushman pe qahar banke barasta hai ali
maula maula, maula maula

3. Haan..
Ahmed ke kaandho'n pe chadhke tod diye but saare
bole ali ye laat o bul se hum jeete tum haare
phir kaaba bola.. ali ali
tera shukr hai maula.. ali ali

4. Haan..
Zarb teri saqlain pe bhaari aur sajdo'n pe sajda
sajdo'n ki tauqeer badhaye maula tera har sajda
Me'raj e ibadat.. ali ali
shajro'n ki taharat.. ali ali
bunyad e imamat.. ali ali
seene mein dil hai, dil mein hai dhadkan

Hoo..
Rab ne sawara ali, rab ne banaya ali
pehle banaya kaaba, usme utara ali
chand sitare bole, darya kanare bole
bheje salami tujhe, arsh ka taara ali
maula maula wird banawa
aayat e qurani ali, rab ki nishani ali
deen ki kahani ali, deen ki jawani ali
khuld mein aana ali, khuld se jaana ali
tere siwa to nahi, koi bahana ali
maula maula wird banawa
ek teri zaat ali, wajh e nijaat ali
tere mawali bane, saari kayenaat ali
rang tere rang ali, tu hai mere sang ali
tera wazeefa padhe tere ye malang ali

5. Haan..
Mid'hat ka qur'aan padho farhan ali waris hai
mazhar ye haq baat kahe aelaan ali waris hai
sab tere hawale.. ali ali
do jag ko paale.. ali ali
mujhe apna banale.. ali ali
